**Finding: Compliant (at/above fallback) — no redline proposed.**

- **§ 8.1** contains a genuine Vendor-side IP indemnity (defend, indemnify and hold harmless Bluefly, its Enterprise and personnel) for patent, trademark, copyright and trade secret claims relating to Materials/Base Components, with standard exclusions and the standard procure/modify/replace/refund remedy ladder and standard claim procedure (with IBM reimbursing our cooperation costs).
- **§ 9.1(a)** carves § 8.1 indemnification payments out of IBM's liability cap, so the indemnity is uncapped — better than the 3× super-cap fallback.
- Noted only in the rationale (not flagged): no separate heads for IBM's breach of law, data breach or gross negligence/wilful misconduct, and the refund remedy is capped at 12 months of charges.
- Our § 8.2 indemnity is wider than the preferred formulation (Services Recipient claims), but § 8.2(c) relieves us to the extent IBM's bad faith, wilful misconduct, gross negligence or breach caused the loss, so it is not one-way/walk-away territory.
